ei.title: The World of Sports Taking Responsibility
ei.subject: 영어2

fullPassage: Stewardship of the environment has become an issue that affects almost all aspects of our lives. Consequently, individuals and organizations constantly strive to make small changes to their daily habits to build a greener environment. Individuals practice a more mindful approach to their way of living to reduce their environmental impact while organizations strive to modify their way of doing business to minimize their effect on the environment. The world of sports is no exception and it has a lot of potential to be part of the solution. Many sporting events have a negative impact on the environment because they require massive structures to host them. To draw more spectators, sports stadiums and sporting facilities are getting bigger, consuming larger areas of land and requiring greater amounts of building materials for construction. Whenever a hectare of grassland is cleared for a construction site, there is a loss of nature. Every ton of concrete and steel used in the building foundation and structure is produced, transported, poured, and put together by equipment and facilities that emit waste into the ground and atmosphere. Then, after the stadium is completed, large amounts of water, electricity, and other forms of resources are consumed to operate and maintain the facility. Every sporting event affects the environment before, during, and even after it. For example, a long-track speed skating competition can only take place, provided that the ice of a 400-meter oval track is frozen until it is 3 to 5 cm thick. As long as the competition is on, the track needs to be kept frozen by specialized refrigeration systems while the temperature, humidity, and air quality inside the stadium also have to be maintained for optimal ice conditions. Additionally, all of the stadium employees, athletes, and spectators need to travel to and from the stadium, often from other cities or even from abroad. In fact, more than 25% of the emissions generated by the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympics are estimated to be caused by fan travel and accommodations. During the event, spectators and athletes eat and drink, and the plastic bottles and wrappers of whatever they consumed leave trash cans overflowing. After the event has ended, in addition to the significant amount of trash that needs to be disposed of, the effects those people caused and the emissions generated from their travel continue to have a lasting negative impact on air quality. Alarm bells sounded when research suggested the possibility that nearly one in every four English soccer stadiums could be partially or completely flooded in the near future due to climate change and extreme weather events. Some research even predicted that by 2050 almost half of the cities that once hosted the Winter Olympics would not be able to do so again for lack of snow and ice. Also, the US Open Tennis Championships organizers implemented an “extreme heat policy,” having mandatory short breaks for players to cool down during matches, after a few quit their matches due to extreme heat. As more sports are affected by climate change, concerns are growing. There is light at the end of the tunnel, however. The sports community is optimistic that it can reduce its environmental impact by taking two main steps: transitioning to more sustainable operations before, during, and after events and raising awareness among the public about their impact. Efforts to adopt more responsible approaches have been made by various organizations, and the International Olympic Committee (IOC) is leading the way by setting a good example. The IOC set up the Sport and Environment Commission decades ago and declared the environment as essential to the Olympic Movement, in addition to sports and culture. It has since encouraged host nations to adopt more environmental approaches to putting on the Olympics. As a result, the Olympic Village built for the 2000 Sydney Summer Olympics became the world’s largest solar-powered suburb and the 2002 Salt Lake City Winter Olympics adopted a new energy recycling system which used the curling hall’s air conditioning unit to heat the showers and bathrooms in the venue. Also, for the 2010 Vancouver Winter Olympics, the Olympic speed-skating venue was built with salvaged timber. The Olympic Park for the 2012 London Summer Olympics, which was built on industrial land that was once contaminated, was converted to the biggest urban park in Europe. Then at the 2020 Tokyo Summer Olympics, electricity was generated with hydrogen instead of fossil fuel, which supplied power for many residential buildings in the Olympic Village and Paralympic Village. Thanks to its popularity, sports is a powerful tool for universally raising awareness about environmental responsibility. Simply put, the sports industry influences billions of individuals that are involved in sports either as spectators, athletes, or organizers. Through sports, strategies to increase awareness and educate the public about the importance of sustaining the environment have shown good results. Research has found that fans are receptive to ecological or environmental initiatives organized at sporting events, and many are willing to change their lifestyle habits accordingly. The social status of athletes can have a strong effect, too. For example, high-profile athletes and coaches can be sports ambassadors to foster environmental consciousness among fans, especially young people who look up to them. The broad appeal of sports becomes a vehicle to reach many people at once. While sports provide us with such immense benefits, we ─ along with sporting event organizers ─need to be aware of the adverse environmental effects that sports have at times. As long as we are all aware of the effects, we can take steps toward finding ways to minimize or even completely eliminate them. While Green Sports Day, on October 6th, is a global event that promotes environmentally friendly sports, maybe it’s time we declare every day a day to encourage greater sustainability in sports. World Link Bioremediation A Sustainable Solution to Ocean Pollution On April 20, 2010, an enormous explosion shook the Deepwater Horizon drilling platform in the Gulf of Mexico, causing a significant oil leak into the sea. Over a three-month period, approximately 134 million gallons of oil, comparable to more than 200 Olympic swimming pools, flowed into the sea before it was eventually halted. Despite continuing restoration efforts, the sea has not yet fully recovered. One approach to addressing the issue of oil contamination is bioremediation, a restoration method that utilizes bacteria. Some types of bacteria naturally exist in marine environments and possess the capability to break down various components of oil. When an oil spill occurs, these bacteria are attracted to the oil and begin to multiply. As they grow, they release enzymes that break down oil into carbon dioxide and water. Although this process may take several weeks or months, it represents a more sustainable method of cleaning up oil spills compared to conventional approaches involving harmful chemicals. Bacteria can also play a role in the process of plastic decomposition. When plastic enters the ocean, some bacteria are attracted to it, leading to their growth and reproduction. Similar to the process of breaking down oil, the bacteria release enzymes that break down plastic into smaller molecules, ultimately resulting in carbon dioxide and water. It’s not all good news, however. There are challenges associated with bioremediation. The breakdown of oil or plastic by bacteria, as mentioned earlier, can be a time-consuming process requiring weeks or months. These bacteria can also be sensitive to specific environmental conditions such as temperature and sea water constituents. Despite these challenges, there is no doubt that bioremediation holds promise as a technology for oil spill or plastic cleanup in the ocean. Because the bacteria used in this process occur naturally, they do not need to be transported to the polluted site. Bioremediation may be a more effective way to confront contamination problems and reduce environmental harm.

questions.passage: Stewardship of the environment ①<u>has become</u> an issue that affects almost all aspects of our lives.  Consequently, individuals and organizations constantly ②<u>strive making</u> small changes to their daily habits to build a greener environment.  Individuals practice a more mindful approach to their way of living to reduce their environmental impact while organizations strive ③<u>to modify</u> their way of doing business to minimize their effect on the environment.  The world of sports is no exception and it has a lot of potential ④<u>to be part</u> of the solution.  Many sporting events have a negative impact on the environment because they require massive structures to host them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② strive making → strive to make: strive(애쓰다)는 뒤에 'to + 동사원형(to부정사)'을 쓰는 동사예요
det.analysis:
① has become: 'Stewardship of the environment has become an issue'는 '환경 관리가 하나의 문제가 되었다'예요. 주어 Stewardship(관리)은 단수이고, '지금까지 ~해 왔다/되었다'라는 현재완료 has become이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② strive making → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 원문은 'organizations constantly strive to make small changes'로 '조직들이 끊임없이 작은 변화를 만들려고 애쓴다'예요. 동사 strive(애쓰다)는 바로 뒤에 'to + 동사원형'을 붙여 'strive to make(만들려고 애쓰다)'로 써야 해요. strive making처럼 -ing를 붙이면 틀려요. ❌ strive making은 틀림 ←정답

③ to modify: 'organizations strive to modify their way of doing business'는 '조직들이 사업 방식을 바꾸려 애쓴다'예요. 여기도 strive 뒤라 to부정사 to modify가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ to be part: 'it has a lot of potential to be part of the solution'은 '그것은 해결책의 일부가 될 큰 잠재력을 지닌다'예요. 명사 potential(잠재력)을 꾸미며 '~할'이라는 뜻의 to부정사 to be가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: strive to + 동사원형(strive to make/modify) = ~하려고 애쓰다

questions.passage: Simply put, the sports industry ①<u>influences</u> billions of individuals that are involved in sports either as spectators, athletes, or organizers.  Through sports, strategies to increase awareness and educate the public about the importance of sustaining the environment ②<u>have shown</u> good results.  Research has found that fans ③<u>are receptive</u> to ecological or environmental initiatives organized at sporting events, and many are willing to change their lifestyle habits accordingly.  The social status of athletes can have a strong effect, too.  For example, high-profile athletes and coaches can be sports ambassadors to foster environmental consciousness among fans, especially young people ④<u>who looks up to</u> them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ who looks up to → who look up to: 관계대명사 who가 복수 명사 young people을 받으므로 동사도 복수 look
det.analysis:
① influences: 'the sports industry influences billions of individuals'는 '스포츠 산업이 수십억 명에게 영향을 준다'예요. 주어 the sports industry(스포츠 산업)는 단수라 동사도 단수형 influences가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② have shown: 'strategies to increase awareness and educate the public ~ have shown good results'는 '인식을 높이고 대중을 교육하는 전략들이 좋은 결과를 보여 주었다'예요. 진짜 주어는 strategies(전략들, 복수)라 동사도 복수형 have shown이 맞아요. 중간에 낀 단수 명사(the public, environment)에 낚이면 안 돼요. ✅ 올바름

③ are receptive: 'fans are receptive to ecological ~ initiatives'는 '팬들이 생태적 활동을 기꺼이 받아들인다'예요. 주어 fans(팬들, 복수)라 be동사도 복수형 are가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ who looks up to → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 원문은 'young people who look up to them'으로 '그들을 우러러보는 젊은 사람들'이에요. 관계대명사 who는 바로 앞의 young people(젊은 사람들, 복수)을 받으므로, who절의 동사도 복수형 look이 맞아요. looks는 단수라 틀려요. ❌ who looks up to는 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: 관계대명사 who + 복수 명사(young people) → 동사도 복수 look

questions.passage: When an oil spill occurs, these bacteria ①<u>are attracted</u> to the oil and begin to multiply.  As they grow, they ②<u>release</u> enzymes that break down oil into carbon dioxide and water.  Although this process may take several weeks or months, it represents a more sustainable method of cleaning up oil spills compared to conventional approaches involving harmful chemicals.  Bacteria can also play a role in the process of plastic decomposition.  When plastic enters the ocean, some bacteria are attracted to it, ③<u>led to their growth</u> and reproduction.  Similar to the process of breaking down oil, the bacteria release enzymes that break down plastic into smaller molecules, ultimately ④<u>resulting</u> in carbon dioxide and water.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ led → leading: 콤마 뒤에서 '그래서 ~하다'로 이어지는 분사구문이라 현재분사 leading
det.analysis:
① are attracted: 'these bacteria are attracted to the oil'은 '이 박테리아들은 기름에 이끌린다'예요. 박테리아는 스스로 끌어당기는 게 아니라 기름에 '이끌리는' 대상이라 수동태 are attracted가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② release: 'they release enzymes that break down oil'은 '그것들은 기름을 분해하는 효소를 방출한다'예요. 주어 they(그들 = 박테리아, 복수)라 동사도 복수형 release가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ led → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 원문은 'some bacteria are attracted to it, leading to their growth and reproduction'으로 '일부 박테리아가 그것에 이끌려서, 그 결과 성장과 번식으로 이어진다'예요. 콤마 뒤에 '그래서 ~하다'라고 이어 주는 부분은 분사구문이라 현재분사 leading을 써야 해요. led는 과거형 동사인데 앞에 접속사(and 등)가 없어 문장에 동사가 두 개가 되어 틀려요. ❌ led는 틀림 ←정답

④ resulting: 'break down plastic into smaller molecules, ultimately resulting in carbon dioxide and water'는 '플라스틱을 더 작은 분자로 분해하여, 결국 이산화탄소와 물이 된다'예요. 콤마 뒤에서 '그래서 ~하다'로 이어지는 분사구문이라 현재분사 resulting이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 콤마 뒤 '그래서 ~하다'는 분사구문 → 현재분사(leading/resulting)

questions.passage: Many sporting events have a ①<u>positive</u> impact on the environment because they require massive structures to host them.  To draw more spectators, sports stadiums and sporting facilities are getting ②<u>bigger</u>, consuming larger areas of land and requiring greater amounts of building materials for construction.  Whenever a hectare of grassland is cleared for a construction site, there is a ③<u>loss</u> of nature.  Every ton of concrete and steel used in the building foundation and structure is produced, transported, poured, and put together by equipment and facilities that ④<u>emit</u> waste into the ground and atmosphere.  Then, after the stadium is completed, large amounts of water, electricity, and other forms of resources are consumed to operate and maintain the facility.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① positive → negative: 경기장이 거대 구조물을 필요로 해 환경에 '부정적' 영향을 준다는 흐름
det.analysis:
① positive → 여기가 정답(부적절한 곳)! 원문은 'Many sporting events have a negative impact on the environment'로 '많은 스포츠 경기가 환경에 부정적 영향을 준다'예요. 바로 뒤에 '거대한 구조물을 필요로 하기 때문(they require massive structures)'이라는 이유가 이어지고, 뒷부분도 땅 소비·자연 손실 같은 나쁜 영향을 말해요. 그러니 '긍정적(positive)'이 아니라 '부정적(negative)'이어야 흐름이 맞아요. positive는 정반대라 부적절해요. ❌ 부적절 ←정답

② bigger: 'sports stadiums and sporting facilities are getting bigger'는 '경기장과 스포츠 시설이 점점 커지고 있다'예요. 더 많은 관중을 끌기 위해 시설이 '커진다'는 흐름이라 자연스러워요. ✅ 적절

③ loss: 'Whenever a hectare of grassland is cleared ~, there is a loss of nature'는 '초지가 개간될 때마다 자연의 손실이 있다'예요. 땅을 밀어 공사장을 만들면 자연이 '사라지는' 것이라 loss(손실)가 맞아요. ✅ 적절

④ emit: 'equipment and facilities that emit waste into the ground and atmosphere'는 '땅과 대기로 폐기물을 배출하는 장비와 시설'이에요. 오염을 일으키는 장비가 폐기물을 '배출하다(emit)'가 자연스러워요. ✅ 적절
det.tip: 거대 구조물 필요·자연 손실 → 환경에 부정적(negative) 영향. positive는 반대

questions.passage: Alarm bells sounded when research suggested the possibility that nearly one in every four English soccer stadiums could be partially or completely ①<u>flooded</u> in the near future due to climate change and extreme weather events.  Some research even predicted that by 2050 almost half of the cities that once hosted the Winter Olympics would not be able to do so again for ②<u>abundance</u> of snow and ice.  Also, the US Open Tennis Championships organizers implemented an “extreme heat policy,” having mandatory short breaks for players to ③<u>cool down</u> during matches, after a few quit their matches due to extreme heat.  As more sports are affected by climate change, concerns are ④<u>growing</u>.  There is light at the end of the tunnel, however.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② abundance → lack: 눈과 얼음이 '부족해서' 개최를 다시 할 수 없다는 흐름
det.analysis:
① flooded: 'nearly one in every four English soccer stadiums could be ~ flooded'는 '잉글랜드 축구 경기장 네 곳 중 거의 한 곳이 물에 잠길 수 있다'예요. 기후 변화와 극한 날씨 때문에 경기장이 '침수될(flooded)' 수 있다는 흐름이라 자연스러워요. ✅ 적절

② abundance → 여기가 정답(부적절한 곳)! 원문은 'would not be able to do so again for lack of snow and ice'로 '눈과 얼음의 부족으로 다시 개최할 수 없을 것'이에요. 눈과 얼음이 '부족해야(lack)' 동계올림픽을 못 여는 것이죠. abundance(풍부함)는 오히려 눈이 많다는 뜻이라 '개최 불가'와 정반대예요. ❌ 부적절 ←정답

③ cool down: 'mandatory short breaks for players to cool down during matches'는 '경기 중 선수들이 열을 식히도록 하는 의무적인 짧은 휴식'이에요. 극심한 더위에 선수들이 몸을 '식히다(cool down)'가 자연스러워요. ✅ 적절

④ growing: 'As more sports are affected by climate change, concerns are growing'은 '더 많은 스포츠가 기후 변화의 영향을 받으면서 우려가 커지고 있다'예요. 문제가 늘면 걱정도 '커지는(growing)' 것이라 맞아요. ✅ 적절
det.tip: 눈·얼음이 부족(lack)해서 개최 불가. 풍부함(abundance)은 반대

questions.passage: The social status of athletes can have a strong effect, too.  For example, high-profile athletes and coaches can be sports ambassadors to foster environmental consciousness among fans, especially young people who look up to them.  The broad appeal of sports becomes a vehicle to reach many people at once.  While sports provide us with such immense benefits, we ─ along with sporting event organizers ─need to be aware of the __________ that sports have at times.  As long as we are all aware of the effects, we can take steps toward finding ways to minimize or even completely eliminate them.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ adverse environmental effects(부정적 환경 영향): 스포츠가 때때로 주는 나쁜 환경 영향을 인식해야 한다는 흐름
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'we ~ need to be aware of the ______ that sports have at times'(우리는 스포츠가 때때로 지니는 ______을 알아야 한다). 바로 다음 문장에서 'As long as we are all aware of the effects, we can take steps toward finding ways to minimize or even completely eliminate them'(그 영향을 알면 최소화하거나 완전히 없앨 방법을 찾을 수 있다)이라고 해요. 즉 빈칸은 '없애야 할 나쁜 영향'이어야 해요.

❌ ① economic growth opportunities(경제 성장 기회): 없애야 할 대상이 아니라 좋은 것이라 흐름과 안 맞아요.

❌ ② exciting sporting moments(흥미진진한 스포츠 순간): 최소화·제거할 대상이 아니에요.

❌ ③ global media attention(전 세계 언론의 관심): 나쁜 영향과 관련이 없어요.

✅ ④ adverse environmental effects(부정적 환경 영향): 뒤 문장의 '최소화하거나 없앤다'와 딱 맞는, 스포츠가 주는 나쁜 환경 영향이에요. ←정답
det.tip: 뒤에 '최소화·제거한다' → 빈칸은 없애야 할 부정적 환경 영향

questions.passage: Thanks to its popularity, sports is a powerful tool for universally raising awareness about environmental responsibility.  Simply put, the sports industry influences billions of individuals that are involved in sports either as spectators, athletes, or organizers.  Through sports, strategies to increase awareness and educate the public about the importance of sustaining the environment have shown __________.  Research has found that fans are receptive to ecological or environmental initiatives organized at sporting events, and many are willing to change their lifestyle habits accordingly.  The social status of athletes can have a strong effect, too.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ③ good results(좋은 결과): 팬들이 환경 활동을 잘 받아들이는 등 인식 제고 전략이 성과를 냈다는 흐름
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'strategies to increase awareness and educate the public ~ have shown ______'(인식을 높이고 대중을 교육하는 전략들이 ______을 보여 주었다). 바로 다음 문장에서 'fans are receptive to ~ environmental initiatives ~ and many are willing to change their lifestyle habits'(팬들이 환경 활동을 기꺼이 받아들이고, 많은 이가 생활 습관을 바꾸려 한다)이라며 긍정적인 반응을 말해요. 그러니 빈칸은 '좋은 성과'여야 해요.

❌ ① little interest(거의 관심 없음): 팬들이 적극 반응한다는 뒤 내용과 반대예요.

❌ ② serious problems(심각한 문제): 긍정적 흐름과 안 맞아요.

✅ ③ good results(좋은 결과): 팬들이 잘 받아들이고 습관을 바꾼다는 성과와 딱 맞아요. ←정답

❌ ④ mixed reviews(엇갈린 반응): 긍정적 결과만 이어지므로 '엇갈린'은 부적절해요.
det.tip: 뒤에 팬들의 적극적 반응 → 전략이 좋은 결과(good results)를 냄

questions.passage: Many sporting events have a negative impact on the environment because they require massive structures to host them.  To draw more spectators, sports stadiums and sporting facilities are getting bigger, consuming larger areas of land and requiring greater amounts of building materials for construction.  Whenever a hectare of grassland is cleared for a construction site, there is a loss of nature.  Every ton of concrete and steel used in the building foundation and structure is produced, transported, poured, and put together by equipment and facilities that emit waste into the ground and atmosphere.  Then, after the stadium is completed, large amounts of water, electricity, and other forms of resources are consumed to operate and maintain the facility.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ① 원문 근거: Every ton of concrete and steel ~ is produced, transported, poured ~ by equipment and facilities that emit waste
det.analysis:
✅ ① 원문 'Every ton of concrete and steel ~ is produced, transported, poured, and put together by equipment and facilities that emit waste into the ground and atmosphere'(콘크리트와 강철은 폐기물을 배출하는 장비와 시설로 생산·운송·타설·조립된다)와 일치해요. ←정답

❌ ② 원문 'Many sporting events have a negative impact on the environment'(많은 스포츠 경기는 환경에 부정적 영향을 준다)과 반대예요. '오직 긍정적'이 아니에요.

❌ ③ 원문 'Whenever a hectare of grassland is cleared ~, there is a loss of nature'(초지가 개간될 때마다 자연의 손실이 있다)와 반대예요. 손실이 '없다'는 틀려요.

❌ ④ 원문 'large amounts of water, electricity, and other forms of resources are consumed to operate and maintain the facility'(시설 운영·유지를 위해 많은 물·전기·자원이 소비된다)와 반대예요. '거의 소비되지 않는다'는 틀려요.
det.tip: 함정: 부정적 영향 있음 / 자연 손실 있음 / 완공 후 자원 많이 소비됨

ch: 경기장 건설에 쓰이는 콘크리트와 강철은 폐기물을 배출하는 장비와 시설로 생산·운송·타설된다.
스포츠 경기는 환경에 오직 긍정적인 영향만 미친다.
초지가 공사장으로 개간되어도 자연의 손실은 전혀 발생하지 않는다.
경기장이 완공된 뒤에는 물과 전기 같은 자원이 거의 소비되지 않는다.

questions.passage: Some types of bacteria naturally exist in marine environments and possess the capability to break down various components of oil.  When an oil spill occurs, these bacteria are attracted to the oil and begin to multiply.  As they grow, they release enzymes that break down oil into carbon dioxide and water.  Although this process may take several weeks or months, it represents a more sustainable method of cleaning up oil spills compared to conventional approaches involving harmful chemicals.  Bacteria can also play a role in the process of plastic decomposition.  When plastic enters the ocean, some bacteria are attracted to it, leading to their growth and reproduction.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ② 원문 'Bacteria can also play a role in the process of plastic decomposition'과 반대 → 일치하지 않음
det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문 'Some types of bacteria naturally exist in marine environments and possess the capability to break down various components of oil'(일부 박테리아는 해양 환경에 자연적으로 존재하며 기름의 여러 성분을 분해할 수 있다)과 일치해요.

✅ ② 여기가 정답(일치하지 않는 것)! 원문은 'Bacteria can also play a role in the process of plastic decomposition'(박테리아는 플라스틱 분해 과정에서도 역할을 할 수 있다)이에요. 즉 플라스틱도 분해해요. '플라스틱은 전혀 분해하지 못한다'는 사실과 반대라 틀려요. ←정답

❌ ③ 원문 'When an oil spill occurs, these bacteria are attracted to the oil and begin to multiply'(기름 유출이 생기면 박테리아가 기름에 이끌려 증식하기 시작한다)와 일치해요.

❌ ④ 원문 'When plastic enters the ocean, some bacteria are attracted to it, leading to their growth and reproduction'(플라스틱이 바다에 들어가면 일부 박테리아가 이끌려 성장·번식한다)과 일치해요.
det.tip: 박테리아는 기름뿐 아니라 플라스틱도 분해함 → ②가 틀림

ch: 일부 박테리아는 해양 환경에 자연적으로 존재하며 기름의 여러 성분을 분해할 수 있다.
박테리아는 기름은 분해하지만 플라스틱은 전혀 분해하지 못한다.
기름 유출이 발생하면 박테리아가 기름에 이끌려 증식하기 시작한다.
플라스틱이 바다에 들어가면 일부 박테리아가 그것에 이끌려 성장하고 번식한다.

questions.passage: It has since encouraged host nations to adopt more environmental approaches to putting on the Olympics.  As a result, the Olympic Village built for the 2000 Sydney Summer Olympics became the world’s largest solar-powered suburb and the 2002 Salt Lake City Winter Olympics adopted a new energy recycling system which used the curling hall’s air conditioning unit to heat the showers and bathrooms in the venue.  Also, for the 2010 Vancouver Winter Olympics, the Olympic speed-skating venue was built with salvaged timber.  The Olympic Park for the 2012 London Summer Olympics, which was built on industrial land that was once contaminated, was converted to the biggest urban park in Europe.  Then at the 2020 Tokyo Summer Olympics, electricity was generated with hydrogen instead of fossil fuel, which supplied power for many residential buildings in the Olympic Village and Paralympic Village.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ④ 원문 근거: electricity was generated with hydrogen instead of fossil fuel, which supplied power for many residential buildings in the Olympic Village
det.analysis:
❌ ① 원문 'the Olympic Village built for the 2000 Sydney Summer Olympics became the world's largest solar-powered suburb'(시드니 선수촌은 세계 최대 태양광 발전 주거지가 되었다)과 반대예요. 태양광을 '전혀 활용 안 했다'는 틀려요.

❌ ② 원문 'The Olympic Park ~ which was built on industrial land that was once contaminated'(한때 오염되었던 산업 부지 위에 지어졌다)와 반대예요. '오염된 적 없는 깨끗한 농지'가 아니에요.

❌ ③ 원문 '2002 Salt Lake City Winter Olympics adopted a new energy recycling system'(솔트레이크시티는 새로운 에너지 재활용 시스템을 도입했다)과 반대예요. '도입을 거부'가 아니에요.

✅ ④ 원문 'at the 2020 Tokyo Summer Olympics, electricity was generated with hydrogen instead of fossil fuel, which supplied power for many residential buildings in the Olympic Village'(도쿄에서는 화석 연료 대신 수소로 전기를 만들어 선수촌 건물에 전력을 공급했다)와 일치해요. ←정답
det.tip: 함정: 시드니=태양광 활용 / 런던=오염된 부지 / 솔트레이크=재활용 도입 / 도쿄=수소 전기(정답)

ch: 2000년 시드니 하계올림픽 선수촌은 태양광을 전혀 활용하지 않았다.
2012년 런던 하계올림픽 공원은 오염된 적 없는 깨끗한 농지 위에 지어졌다.
2002년 솔트레이크시티 동계올림픽은 에너지 재활용 시스템 도입을 거부했다.
2020년 도쿄 하계올림픽에서는 화석 연료 대신 수소로 전기를 생산해 선수촌에 전력을 공급했다.

questions.passage: Stewardship of the environment has become an issue that affects almost all aspects of our lives.  Consequently, individuals and organizations constantly strive to make small changes to their daily habits to build a greener environment.  Individuals practice a more mindful approach to their way of living to reduce their environmental impact while organizations strive to modify their way of doing business to minimize their effect on the environment.  The world of sports is no exception and it has a lot of potential to be part of the solution.  Many sporting events have a negative impact on the environment because they require massive structures to host them.  To draw more spectators, sports stadiums and sporting facilities are getting bigger, consuming larger areas of land and requiring greater amounts of building materials for construction.  Whenever a hectare of grassland is cleared for a construction site, there is a loss of nature.  Every ton of concrete and steel used in the building foundation and structure is produced, transported, poured, and put together by equipment and facilities that emit waste into the ground and atmosphere.  Then, after the stadium is completed, large amounts of water, electricity, and other forms of resources are consumed to operate and maintain the facility.  Every sporting event affects the environment before, during, and even after it.  For example, a long-track speed skating competition can only take place, provided that the ice of a 400-meter oval track is frozen until it is 3 to 5 cm thick.  As long as the competition is on, the track needs to be kept frozen by specialized refrigeration systems while the temperature, humidity, and air quality inside the stadium also have to be maintained for optimal ice conditions.  Additionally, all of the stadium employees, athletes, and spectators need to travel to and from the stadium, often from other cities or even from abroad.  In fact, more than 25% of the emissions generated by the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympics are estimated to be caused by fan travel and accommodations.  During the event, spectators and athletes eat and drink, and the plastic bottles and wrappers of whatever they consumed leave trash cans overflowing.  After the event has ended, in addition to the significant amount of trash that needs to be disposed of, the effects those people caused and the emissions generated from their travel continue to have a lasting negative impact on air quality.  Alarm bells sounded when research suggested the possibility that nearly one in every four English soccer stadiums could be partially or completely flooded in the near future due to climate change and extreme weather events.  Some research even predicted that by 2050 almost half of the cities that once hosted the Winter Olympics would not be able to do so again for lack of snow and ice.  Also, the US Open Tennis Championships organizers implemented an “extreme heat policy,” having mandatory short breaks for players to cool down during matches, after a few quit their matches due to extreme heat.  As more sports are affected by climate change, concerns are growing.  There is light at the end of the tunnel, however.  The sports community is optimistic that it can reduce its environmental impact by taking two main steps: transitioning to more sustainable operations before, during, and after events and raising awareness among the public about their impact.  Efforts to adopt more responsible approaches have been made by various organizations, and the International Olympic Committee (IOC) is leading the way by setting a good example.  The IOC set up the Sport and Environment Commission decades ago and declared the environment as essential to the Olympic Movement, in addition to sports and culture.  It has since encouraged host nations to adopt more environmental approaches to putting on the Olympics.  As a result, the Olympic Village built for the 2000 Sydney Summer Olympics became the world’s largest solar-powered suburb and the 2002 Salt Lake City Winter Olympics adopted a new energy recycling system which used the curling hall’s air conditioning unit to heat the showers and bathrooms in the venue.  Also, for the 2010 Vancouver Winter Olympics, the Olympic speed-skating venue was built with salvaged timber.  The Olympic Park for the 2012 London Summer Olympics, which was built on industrial land that was once contaminated, was converted to the biggest urban park in Europe.  Then at the 2020 Tokyo Summer Olympics, electricity was generated with hydrogen instead of fossil fuel, which supplied power for many residential buildings in the Olympic Village and Paralympic Village.  Thanks to its popularity, sports is a powerful tool for universally raising awareness about environmental responsibility.  Simply put, the sports industry influences billions of individuals that are involved in sports either as spectators, athletes, or organizers.  Through sports, strategies to increase awareness and educate the public about the importance of sustaining the environment have shown good results.  Research has found that fans are receptive to ecological or environmental initiatives organized at sporting events, and many are willing to change their lifestyle habits accordingly.  The social status of athletes can have a strong effect, too.  For example, high-profile athletes and coaches can be sports ambassadors to foster environmental consciousness among fans, especially young people who look up to them.  The broad appeal of sports becomes a vehicle to reach many people at once.  While sports provide us with such immense benefits, we ─ along with sporting event organizers ─need to be aware of the adverse environmental effects that sports have at times.  As long as we are all aware of the effects, we can take steps toward finding ways to minimize or even completely eliminate them.  While Green Sports Day, on October 6th, is a global event that promotes environmentally friendly sports, maybe it’s time we declare every day a day to encourage greater sustainability in sports.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 스포츠가 환경에 주는 부정적 영향과 이를 줄이려는 스포츠계의 노력·인식 제고
det.analysis:
이 글은 앞부분에서 스포츠가 경기장 건설·이동 배출 등으로 환경에 부정적 영향을 준다고 하고, 뒷부분에서 지속 가능한 운영으로 전환하고 대중의 인식을 높여 그 영향을 줄이려는 스포츠계의 노력(IOC 사례 등)을 설명해요.

✅ ① 스포츠의 부정적 환경 영향 + 이를 줄이려는 노력과 인식 제고: 글 전체를 아우르는 주제예요. ←정답

❌ ② 관중을 늘리는 마케팅 전략: 경기장이 커지는 이유로 잠깐 언급될 뿐 주제가 아니에요.

❌ ③ 개최 도시의 경제적 어려움과 재정 지원: 글에 나오지 않는 내용이에요.

❌ ④ 선수의 사회적 지위와 연봉: 선수의 영향력이 잠깐 나오지만 연봉 이야기는 없고 주제도 아니에요.
det.tip: 주제는 글 전체를 포괄: '부정적 영향 + 줄이려는 노력'이 핵심

ch: 스포츠가 환경에 끼치는 부정적 영향과 이를 줄이기 위한 스포츠계의 노력 및 인식 제고의 중요성
대형 스포츠 경기장을 건설할 때 관중을 늘리기 위한 마케팅 전략

det.korean: ④ 어려운 상황 속에서도 환경 문제를 개선할 수 있다는 희망
det.analysis:
밑줄 문장: 'There is light at the end of the tunnel, however'(하지만 터널 끝에는 빛이 있다). 앞에서는 경기장 침수, 개최 도시 감소, 폭염 등 기후 변화로 우려가 커진다는 어두운 이야기가 이어졌어요. 그런데 바로 뒤 문장부터 'The sports community is optimistic that it can reduce its environmental impact'(스포츠계는 환경 영향을 줄일 수 있다고 낙관한다)처럼 해결책이 나와요. 'light at the end of the tunnel'은 '긴 터널(어려움) 끝의 빛', 즉 힘든 상황에도 있는 '희망'을 뜻하는 관용 표현이에요.

❌ ① 경기장 조명 교체 계획: 실제 '조명(빛)'을 말하는 게 아니라 비유예요.

❌ ② 터널 공사가 끝난다는 소식: 진짜 터널 이야기가 아니에요.

❌ ③ 스포츠 산업의 쇠퇴 경고: 뒤에 희망적인 해결책이 나오므로 반대예요.

✅ ④ 어려운 상황 속에서도 개선할 수 있다는 희망: 뒤에 이어지는 낙관적 해결책과 딱 맞아요. ←정답
det.tip: light at the end of the tunnel = 힘든 상황 끝의 희망 (뒤에 낙관적 해결책이 단서)

ch: 경기장 조명을 에너지 효율적인 것으로 교체하려는 계획
터널 공사가 곧 끝나 교통이 원활해진다는 소식
스포츠 산업이 결국 쇠퇴할 것이라는 경고
어려운 상황 속에서도 환경 문제를 개선할 수 있다는 희망

questions.passage: Efforts to adopt more responsible approaches have been made by various organizations, and the International Olympic Committee (IOC) is leading the way by setting a good example.  The IOC set up the Sport and Environment Commission decades ago and declared the environment as essential to the Olympic Movement, in addition to sports and culture.  <u>It has since encouraged host nations to adopt more environmental approaches</u> to putting on the Olympics.  As a result, the Olympic Village built for the 2000 Sydney Summer Olympics became the world’s largest solar-powered suburb and the 2002 Salt Lake City Winter Olympics adopted a new energy recycling system which used the curling hall’s air conditioning unit to heat the showers and bathrooms in the venue.  Also, for the 2010 Vancouver Winter Olympics, the Olympic speed-skating venue was built with salvaged timber.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 It이 가리키는 대상으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① 국제올림픽위원회(IOC): It = 앞에서 좋은 본보기를 보이는 주체인 the IOC
det.analysis:
밑줄 문장: 'It has since encouraged host nations to adopt more environmental approaches to putting on the Olympics'(그 이후로 그것은 개최국들이 올림픽을 여는 데 더 친환경적인 방식을 채택하도록 장려해 왔다). 앞 문장들을 보면 'the International Olympic Committee (IOC) is leading the way by setting a good example'(IOC가 좋은 본보기로 앞장서고 있다), 'The IOC set up the Sport and Environment Commission ~ and declared the environment as essential'(IOC가 위원회를 만들고 환경을 필수 요소로 선언했다)이라고 했어요. 즉 개최국들에게 친환경 방식을 '장려하는' 주체는 the IOC예요.

✅ ① 국제올림픽위원회(IOC): 앞에서 본보기를 보이며 환경을 선언한 주체라 딱 맞아요. ←정답

❌ ② 시드니 선수촌: 뒤에 결과로 나오는 예시일 뿐 '장려하는' 주체가 아니에요.

❌ ③ 올림픽 운동: 바로 앞에 나오지만, 개최국에게 무언가를 장려하는 주체가 아니라 IOC가 '필수'라고 선언한 대상이에요.

❌ ④ 개최 후보 도시들: 이들은 장려를 '받는' 대상(host nations)이지 주체가 아니에요.
det.tip: It = 좋은 본보기로 앞장서며 환경을 선언한 주체 the IOC (바로 앞 명사 아님)

ch: 환경 승인을 받으려는 개최 후보 도시들

questions.passage: As long as the competition is on, the track needs to be kept frozen by specialized refrigeration systems while the temperature, humidity, and air quality inside the stadium also have to be maintained for optimal ice conditions.  Additionally, all of the stadium employees, athletes, and spectators need to travel to and from the stadium, often from other cities or even from abroad.  In fact, more than 25% of the emissions generated by the 2018 PyeongChang Winter Olympics are estimated to be caused by __________.  During the event, spectators and athletes eat and drink, and the plastic bottles and wrappers of whatever they consumed leave trash cans overflowing.  After the event has ended, in addition to the significant amount of trash that needs to be disposed of, the effects those people caused and the emissions generated from their travel continue to have a lasting negative impact on air quality.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② fan travel and accommodations(팬들의 이동과 숙박): 관중·선수가 다른 도시나 해외에서 이동한다는 앞 내용이 단서
det.analysis:
빈칸 문장: 'more than 25% of the emissions ~ are estimated to be caused by ______'(배출량의 25% 이상이 ______에 의해 발생한 것으로 추정된다). 바로 앞 문장에서 'all of the stadium employees, athletes, and spectators need to travel to and from the stadium, often from other cities or even from abroad'(직원·선수·관중이 다른 도시나 해외에서 경기장을 오가야 한다)이라고 했어요. 즉 배출의 원인은 사람들의 '이동과 숙박'이에요.

❌ ① stadium lighting systems(경기장 조명 시스템): 이동 이야기와 관련이 없어요.

✅ ② fan travel and accommodations(팬들의 이동과 숙박): 앞 문장의 '다른 도시·해외에서의 이동'과 딱 맞아요. ←정답

❌ ③ athlete training programs(선수 훈련 프로그램): 훈련 이야기는 나오지 않아요.

❌ ④ ticket sales operations(입장권 판매 운영): 판매와 배출을 연결하는 내용이 없어요.
det.tip: 앞 문장 '다른 도시·해외에서 오간다' → 배출 원인은 팬들의 이동과 숙박

questions.passage: One approach to addressing the issue of oil contamination is bioremediation, a restoration method that utilizes bacteria.  Some types of bacteria naturally exist in marine environments and possess the capability to break down various components of oil.  When an oil spill occurs, __________ and begin to multiply.  As they grow, they release enzymes that break down oil into carbon dioxide and water.  Although this process may take several weeks or months, it represents a more sustainable method of cleaning up oil spills compared to conventional approaches involving harmful chemicals.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"이 박테리아들은 기름에 이끌린다." (7단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) are, attracted, bacteria, oil, the, these, to 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: these bacteria are attracted to the oil
det.analysis:
'이 박테리아들은 기름에 이끌린다'가 핵심이에요.

먼저 주어 '이 박테리아들'은 these bacteria로 놓아요: these → bacteria.

'이끌린다'는 박테리아가 스스로 끌어당기는 게 아니라 '이끌리는' 것이므로 수동태 'be동사 + 과거분사'를 써요. 주어가 복수(bacteria)라 be동사는 are를 쓰고, attract(끌어당기다)의 과거분사 attracted를 붙여요: are → attracted.

'기름에'는 'to + 명사'로 나타내요. be attracted to ~ = '~에 이끌리다'라는 표현이에요: to → the → oil.

순서대로 이으면 these / bacteria / are / attracted / to / the / oil.
det.tip: be attracted to + 명사 = ~에 이끌리다 (수동태 are attracted)

questions.wa: these bacteria are attracted to the oil
accept: these bacteria are attracted to the oil

questions.passage: It has since encouraged host nations to adopt more environmental approaches to putting on the Olympics.  As a result, the Olympic Village built for the 2000 Sydney Summer Olympics became the world’s largest solar-powered suburb and the 2002 Salt Lake City Winter Olympics adopted a new energy recycling system which used the curling hall’s air conditioning unit to heat the showers and bathrooms in the venue.  Also, for the 2010 Vancouver Winter Olympics, the Olympic speed-skating venue was built with salvaged timber.  The Olympic Park for the 2012 London Summer Olympics, which was built on industrial land that was once contaminated, ①<u>was converting</u> to the biggest urban park in Europe.  Then at the 2020 Tokyo Summer Olympics, electricity was generated with hydrogen instead of fossil fuel, which supplied power for many residential buildings in the Olympic Village and Paralympic Village.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①은 어법상 틀렸다. 어법에 맞게 올바른 형태로 고쳐 쓰시오. (한 단어, 영어로)

det.korean: was converting → was converted: 공원이 '바뀌어진' 대상이라 수동태 be + 과거분사 converted
det.analysis:
밑줄이 있는 문장은 'The Olympic Park for the 2012 London Summer Olympics, which was built on industrial land that was once contaminated, ①<u>was converting</u> to the biggest urban park in Europe'예요. '2012 런던 올림픽 공원은, 한때 오염되었던 산업 부지 위에 지어졌는데, 유럽 최대의 도시 공원으로 바뀌었다'라는 뜻이에요.

중간에 콤마로 낀 'which was built ~ contaminated'는 공원을 설명하는 부분이고, 문장의 진짜 동사가 밑줄 부분이에요. 공원은 스스로 바꾸는 게 아니라 '바뀌어지는' 대상이므로 수동태 'be동사 + 과거분사(p.p.)'를 써야 해요.

그래서 was converting(능동·진행)이 아니라 was converted(바뀌었다, 수동)로 고쳐야 맞아요. convert(바꾸다)의 과거분사는 converted예요.
det.tip: 공원이 '바뀌어진' 대상 → 수동태 was converted (be + 과거분사)

questions.passage: The social status of athletes can have a strong effect, too.  For example, high-profile athletes and coaches can be sports ambassadors to foster environmental consciousness among fans, especially young people who look up to them.  __________ to reach many people at once.  While sports provide us with such immense benefits, we ─ along with sporting event organizers ─need to be aware of the adverse environmental effects that sports have at times.  As long as we are all aware of the effects, we can take steps toward finding ways to minimize or even completely eliminate them.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"스포츠의 폭넓은 매력은 하나의 수단이 된다." (8단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) a, appeal, becomes, broad, of, sports, The, vehicle 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 8단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: The broad appeal of sports becomes a vehicle
det.analysis:
'스포츠의 폭넓은 매력은 하나의 수단이 된다'가 핵심이에요.

먼저 주어 '스포츠의 폭넓은 매력'을 만들어요. 'A of B'는 'B의 A'라는 뜻이라, '스포츠의 폭넓은 매력'은 The broad appeal of sports로 놓아요: The → broad → appeal → of → sports.

'~이 된다'는 동사 become으로 나타내는데, 주어의 핵심이 단수 appeal(매력)이라 동사도 단수형 becomes를 써요: becomes.

'하나의 수단'은 셀 수 있는 명사라 관사 a를 붙여 a vehicle로 놓아요: a → vehicle.

순서대로 이으면 The / broad / appeal / of / sports / becomes / a / vehicle.
det.tip: A of B = B의 A / 단수 주어(appeal) → 동사도 단수 becomes

questions.wa: The broad appeal of sports becomes a vehicle
accept: The broad appeal of sports becomes a vehicle

questions.passage: When an oil spill occurs, these bacteria are attracted to the oil and begin to multiply.  As they grow, they release enzymes that break down oil into carbon dioxide and water.  Although this process may take several weeks or months, __________ compared to conventional approaches involving harmful chemicals.  Bacteria can also play a role in the process of plastic decomposition.  When plastic enters the ocean, some bacteria are attracted to it, leading to their growth and reproduction.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오.
"그것은 기름 유출을 정화하는 더 지속 가능한 방법을 나타낸다."

[ a / cleaning / it / method / more / of / oil / represents / spills / sustainable / up ] (11단어) (영어로)

det.korean: it represents a more sustainable method of cleaning up oil spills
det.analysis:
'그것은 ~한 방법을 나타낸다'를 영어 어순으로 놓아요.

먼저 주어와 동사: it(그것은) + represents(나타낸다). 주어 it이 단수라 동사도 단수형 represents예요.

'더 지속 가능한 방법'은 a more sustainable method로 놓아요. 형용사를 more로 비교급으로 만들어 method(방법)를 꾸며요: a → more → sustainable → method.

'기름 유출을 정화하는'은 method를 뒤에서 꾸미는 말이에요. 'of + 동명사(-ing)' 형태로 'of cleaning up oil spills(기름 유출을 정화하는)'로 놓아요. clean up = 깨끗이 치우다: of → cleaning → up → oil → spills.

순서대로 이으면 it / represents / a / more / sustainable / method / of / cleaning / up / oil / spills.
det.tip: method of + 동명사(cleaning) = ~하는 방법 / clean up oil spills = 기름 유출을 정화하다

questions.wa: it represents a more sustainable method of cleaning up oil spills
accept: it represents a more sustainable method of cleaning up oil spills

questions.passage: The breakdown of oil or plastic by bacteria, as mentioned earlier, can be a time-consuming process requiring weeks or months.  These bacteria can also be sensitive to specific environmental conditions such as temperature and sea water constituents.  Despite these challenges, there is no doubt that bioremediation holds promise as a technology for oil spill or plastic cleanup in the ocean.  Because the bacteria used in this process occur naturally, they do not need to be transported to the polluted site.  __________ to confront contamination problems and reduce environmental harm.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"생물학적 정화는 더 효과적인 방법일 수 있다." (7단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) a, be, Bioremediation, effective, may, more, way 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 7단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: Bioremediation may be a more effective way
det.analysis:
'생물학적 정화는 더 효과적인 방법일 수 있다'가 핵심이에요.

먼저 주어 '생물학적 정화'는 Bioremediation으로 놓아요.

'~일 수 있다'는 조동사 may로 나타내고, 그 뒤에는 동사원형 be를 놓아요. 'may be ~'는 '~일 수도 있다'라는 뜻이에요: may → be.

'더 효과적인 방법'은 a more effective way로 놓아요. effective(효과적인)를 more로 비교급으로 만들어 way(방법)를 꾸며요: a → more → effective → way.

순서대로 이으면 Bioremediation / may / be / a / more / effective / way.
det.tip: 조동사(may) + 동사원형(be) / more + 형용사 = 더 ~한 (비교급)

questions.wa: Bioremediation may be a more effective way
accept: Bioremediation may be a more effective way
